findings.evidence: The prior reader language could retain a second cash-performance requirement after the user removed it.
findings.fix_required: State the single total-return objective, define distributions as accounting/product-diligence facts, and remove any cash success test or default disposition.
findings.resolution: The reader now leads with the sole conditional 5% TWRR objective, distribution-once accounting, investor-directed cash use and no automatic or mandatory reinvestment.

findings.evidence: A candidate queue can be mistaken for an allocation menu, and product cash mechanisms can be mistaken for return assurances.
findings.fix_required: Keep T0/T1/T2/T3/T4, q=0, current non-action, item-level research and glossary boundaries reader-facing.
findings.resolution: The report distinguishes the open research universe from a finite approval set, retains the glossary, and makes no purchase, holding, cash-use or implementation instruction.
